title: snATAC-Seq on 10x Chromium Platform for Fresh, Frozen, and Cryopreserved Material
author: Luciano G Martelotto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bda8i2hw

steps.title: Initial Nuclei Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort as many nuclei as possible into a round-bottom 96-well plate well containing 100 µL of ice-cold ATAC Wash Buffer-Dig.

steps.title: First Wash and Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer nuclei from the sorting plate to a 0.2 ml LoBind PCR tube and perform the first wash.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire volume from the well to a 0.2 ml LoBind PCR tube.
Add 50 µL of ATAC Wash Buffer-Dig to the well and transfer any remanent nuclei to the 0.2 ml PCR tube (total volume ~150 µL).

steps.title: First Centrifugation and Supernatant Removal
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei and remove the majority of the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant, leaving behind approximately 10 µL.

steps.title: First Buffer Exchange
steps.instruction: Perform the first buffer exchange using ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Gently add 100 µL ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer without resuspending the nuclei.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove 100 µL of the supernatant in two steps: first remove 90 µL, then remove 10 µL.

steps.title: Second Buffer Exchange
steps.instruction: Perform the second buffer exchange using ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Gently add 100 µL ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer without resuspending the nuclei.
Centrifuge the nuclei at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant (~100 µL) in two steps: first remove 90 µL, then remove as much as possible to leave behind ~7 µL to 10 µL without disturbing the pellet.
If the entire volume was removed without disturbing the pellet, add 7 µL of Diluted Nuclei Buffer.

steps.title: Nuclei Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei in the remaining ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in the ~7 µL to 10 µL of ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer, carefully washing the tube walls to ensure all nuclei are in solution.

steps.title: Nuclei Counting and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify the nuclei and inspect their morphology.

substeps.instruction: Take 1 µL to 2 µL of the suspension and dilute 1:5 with Diluted Nuclei Buffer.
Mix 1:1 with Trypan Blue (centrifuge the TB vial at top speed and use the supernatant) and count nuclei using a Countess II FL Automated Cell Counter or hematocytometer.
Inspect nuclei under a microscope to ensure they are clean and intact.

steps.title: Preparation for 10x Chromium Workflow
steps.instruction: Prepare the nuclei for the Chromium Single Cell ATAC Reagent Kits protocol (CG000168 Rev A).

substeps.instruction: Take 5 µL of nuclei in Diluted Nuclei Buffer and proceed directly to the kit protocol.

For low input samples, use all 5 µL for the Transposition reaction, or calculate the volume needed to reach target recovery using the formula: [Nuclei Concentration x Volume of Nuclei (up to 5 μl)] / 1.53.
